_comment: NEUTRAL EXPANSION — 26 collectible neutrals. Fills the 6-7 top-end hole, the 4-5 midrange, the epic gap, and adds conditional answers/card-advantage tilted to help control decks. Grounded in HS competitive theory: vanilla sets the curve (few pure vanillas as anchors), most bodies get ONE small reason to want them, health-leaning distributions for defense, 'overstat-with-a-leash' for exciting bigs, conditional removal so nothing is an auto-include (neutral paradox). Schema matches cards.set2-legendaries.json. Human source: docs/20-neutral-expansion.md.

cards.name: Village Elder
cards.flavor: Someone has to sit at the gate and have opinions. — Ruth 4.
cards.art: A weathered elder seated at a town gate, staff across his knees, squinting at newcomers.

cards.name: Stonemason
cards.flavor: The stone the builders rejected still had to be cut by somebody. — Psalm 118.
cards.art: A broad artisan chiseling a cornerstone, dust and sun, sleeves rolled.

cards.name: Caravan Master
cards.flavor: Knows every well between here and Haran, and precisely how much you'll complain. — Genesis 24.
cards.art: A trail-worn guide leading laden camels along a ridge at dusk.

cards.name: Threshing Hand
cards.flavor: Separates wheat from chaff for a living. Has thoughts about both. — Matthew 3.
cards.art: A laborer tossing grain into evening air with a wooden fork, chaff drifting.

cards.name: Gleaner
cards.text: Arrival: if your hand is empty, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Takes what falls at the edges. It adds up. — Ruth 2.
cards.art: A young woman gathering leftover barley behind the harvesters, apron full.

cards.name: Night Watch
cards.text: Guard.
cards.flavor: Morning by morning, and still no relief. It's a living. — Isaiah 21.
cards.art: A sentry leaning on a spear atop a wall, cloak heavy, torch guttering before dawn.

cards.name: Almsgiver
cards.text: Arrival: restore 2 to your hero.
cards.flavor: Gave quietly, which is the only way it counts. — Matthew 6.
cards.art: A robed figure pressing a coin into a beggar's hand at a temple step, unshowy.

cards.name: The Potter
cards.text: Arrival: give an ally +0/+2.
cards.flavor: Reworks the marred lump on the wheel and starts again. No lump is wasted. — Jeremiah 18.
cards.art: Hands shaping wet clay on a spinning wheel, a shelf of finished jars behind.

cards.name: Foreign Convert
cards.text: Arrival: give another ally +1/+0.
cards.flavor: 'Your people shall be my people.' Showed up, stayed, out-loyaled everyone. — Ruth 1.
cards.art: A traveler in foreign dress clasping the arm of a local, both a little surprised.

cards.name: Lamp-Bearer
cards.flavor: Kept oil in the flask, unlike some. — Matthew 25.
cards.art: A figure cupping a small clay lamp against the dark, face warm-lit.

cards.name: Master Builder
cards.text: Guard.
cards.flavor: Counted the cost before laying the foundation. Radical concept. — Luke 14.
cards.art: An architect with a measuring reed surveying a half-built tower, scaffolding rising.

cards.name: The Sower
cards.text: Arrival: Foresee 2.
cards.flavor: Scatters wide and lets the soil sort it out. — Mark 4.
cards.art: A farmer casting seed in a broad arc across turned earth, birds wheeling.

cards.name: The Faithful Servant
cards.text: Arrival: draw a card. Legacy: draw a card.
cards.flavor: Two talents in, two talents back, plus interest. Did not bury it. — Matthew 25.
cards.art: A servant weighing coins into two neat stacks, ledger open, lamplight.

cards.name: Kinsman-Redeemer
cards.text: Arrival: return a friendly unit that died this turn to your hand.
cards.flavor: Did it properly, at the gate, with witnesses and a sandal. — Ruth 4.
cards.art: A landowner removing his sandal before elders at a city gate, a woman waiting.

cards.name: The Jar of Oil
cards.text: At the start of your turn, restore 2 to your hero. After 3 turns, this breaks.
cards.flavor: The oil did not run dry until every jar was full. Then it stopped, politely. — 2 Kings 4.
cards.art: A humble clay jar pouring an impossibly steady stream of oil into borrowed vessels.

cards.name: Zealous Defender
cards.text: Swift.
cards.flavor: Drew first and asked questions never. Had to be talked down, twice. — John 18.
cards.art: A broad-shouldered follower stepping in front of his teacher, hand on a short sword.

cards.name: Generous Host
cards.text: Guard. Arrival: restore 3 to your hero.
cards.flavor: Threw the doors open and killed the fatted calf before anyone could object. — Luke 15.
cards.art: A beaming householder ushering travelers to a laden table, lamps blazing.

cards.name: The Plumb Line
cards.text: Destroy a damaged enemy unit.
cards.flavor: Held against the wall to see what was truly crooked. — Amos 7.
cards.art: A weighted cord hanging dead-straight beside a leaning stone wall, judgment implied.

cards.name: Eleventh-Hour Laborer
cards.text: Can't attack unless you played another card this turn.
cards.flavor: Hired at the last hour, paid a full day, and somehow this annoyed everyone. — Matthew 20.
cards.art: A latecomer rolling up his sleeves in a vineyard at golden hour, other workers glaring.

cards.name: Jar of Flour & Oil
cards.text: At the end of your turn, if you have no cards in hand, restore 3 to your hero and draw a card.
cards.flavor: 'It will not run out.' A budget that survives faith and famine alike. — 1 Kings 17.
cards.art: A small clay jar and oil flask on a bare shelf, softly glowing, never emptying.

cards.name: The Faithful Remnant
cards.text: Guard. Arrival: restore 1 to all your other units.
cards.flavor: Seven thousand who had not bowed. Elijah thought he was alone; he wasn't. — 1 Kings 19.
cards.art: A tight knot of resolute figures standing back-to-back on a hill, shields raised, dawn behind.

cards.name: The Cornerstone
cards.text: Guard. Your other units have +0/+1.
cards.flavor: Rejected by the builders. The builders were, in hindsight, mistaken. — Psalm 118.
cards.art: A massive dressed cornerstone set into a foundation, other stones aligning to it, gold-lit.

cards.name: The Measuring Reed
cards.text: Arrival: deal 3 to an enemy and draw a card.
cards.flavor: Measured the temple, the walls, the waters — everything came out exactly to spec. — Ezekiel 40.
cards.art: A luminous surveyor with a golden rod measuring a vast gate, blueprint lines glowing.

cards.name: Barzillai the Aged
cards.text: Arrival: restore 5 to your hero and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Eighty years old, provisioned a whole army in exile, then declined the reward. 'How long have I to live?' Legend. — 2 Samuel 19.
cards.art: A white-bearded patriarch loading provisions onto boats for a weary king, generous and unbothered.

cards.name: The Lone Pilgrim
cards.text: Arrival: if you have no duplicate cards in your deck, draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: Traveled light. Carried exactly one of everything and knew where all of it was. — Hebrews 11.
cards.art: A solitary traveler on an endless road at dawn, a single pack, a single staff, unhurried.

cards.name: The Great Cloud of Witnesses
cards.text: Arrival: give your other units +1/+1 for each other faithful unit you control.
cards.flavor: Surrounded, cheering, and slightly impatient for you to run your leg. — Hebrews 12.
cards.art: A translucent multitude of faithful figures ringing a stadium of light, leaning in, urging forward.
